https://punchng.com/2027-oyo-community-s.body: Development stakeholders in Iseyin, Iseyin Local Government Area of Oyo State, have vowed to support only candidates with visible track records in the 2027 general elections, advocating for purposeful leadership and sincere representation come 2027. The stakeholders, in a communique issued and jointly signed by the President of Ebedi Frontliners, Iseyin, Olusegun Adeleke, and the Secretary, Segun Fasasi, after their meeting at the Palace of Aseyin of Iseyinland, Oba Sefiu Adeyeri, on Saturday, admonished Iseyin people to vote only candidates who would not reverse the tempo of growth and progress, witnessed by the residents. They said, “We have assembled the stakeholders today (Saturday) to discuss the fate of Iseyin in the last several years, under several federal and state administrations, as well as its future. We realised the fact that purposeful leadership, sincere representation and voting for people with track records catapult development of a people than belonging to a ruling political party. “Our people have been sensitised not to vote parties, but individuals with good deeds. This means that our vote will cut across parties in Iseyin. So, we have vowed to support only candidates with visible track records in the 2027 general elections.” The stakeholders further charged them to beware of politicians who might jeopardise the growth of the town, urging them to vote for people with impeccable characters that would build on the legacy projects presently sited in the town. They, therefore, announced that the second leg of the meeting would hold before the general election in January and February, 2027. In his remark, which was delivered by the Head, Aseyin Royal Family, Oyeyemi Oyebola, the Aseyin of Iseyin urged “Iseyin voters to shun thuggery and violence before, during and after the coming elections, as development and growth cannot be achieved under a violent environment.” Dignitaries at the meeting, according to the communique, included the candidates of the All Progressives Congress in House of Representatives – Iseyin/Itesiwaju/Kajola/Iwajowa Federal Constituency, Saheed Alaran; Iseyin/Itesiwaju state House of Assembly under APC, Akande Olufemi; the Allied Peoples’ Movement’s Senatorial candidate for Oyo North Senatorial District, Shina Peller, represented by Hammed Olabisi, and the state House of Assembly under APM – Iseyin/Itesiwaju, Dasola Fadiran. Others were religious bodies, market men and women, artisans, political associations, youths organisations and transport unions. Ademola Adegbite

https://punchng.com/2027-oyo-community-s.body_zh: 奥约州伊塞因地方政府辖区伊塞因的发展利益相关方表示，在2027年大选中，他们只会支持履历清晰可见的候选人，并主张在2027年迎来有明确目标的领导和真诚的代表性。这些利益相关方在星期六于伊塞因land的伊塞因统治者奥巴·塞菲尤·阿德耶里王宫举行会议后，发布了一份由伊塞因Ebedi Frontliners主席奥卢塞贡·阿德莱克和秘书塞贡·法萨西联合签署的公报，敦促伊塞因民众只把选票投给不会逆转当地发展与进步势头的人，居民都见证了这一发展势头。他们说：“我们今天（星期六）召集利益相关方，讨论了伊塞因在过去几年历届联邦政府和州政府执政期间的情况及其未来。我们认识到，有明确目标的领导、真诚的代表性以及把选票投给有履历的人，比属于执政党更能推动一个地区的发展。‘我们的人民已经受到教育，不要投票给政党，而应投票给品行良好的人。这意味着我们在伊塞因的选票将跨越党派。因此，我们发誓在2027年大选中只支持履历清晰可见的候选人。’这些利益相关方还告诫民众提防可能危及该镇发展的政客，敦促他们投票支持品格完美的人，以延续目前在该镇建成的项目。因此，他们宣布，会议的第二阶段将于2027年1月和2月大选前举行。由伊塞因王室首领、伊塞因的统治者奥耶米·奥耶博拉发表的讲话中，他敦促‘伊塞因选民在即将举行的选举前、选举期间和选举后拒绝暴徒行为和暴力，因为只有在没有暴力的环境下才能实现发展和增长。’据公报称，出席会议的各界人士包括全进步大会党在众议院——伊塞因/伊泰西瓦朱/卡乔拉/伊瓦乔瓦联邦选区的候选人萨希德·阿拉兰；全进步大会党在伊塞因/伊泰西瓦朱州议会的候选人阿坎德·奥卢费米；奥约州北区参议员选区人民联盟运动候选人希纳·佩勒，其由哈米德·奥拉比西代表；以及人民联盟运动在伊塞因/伊泰西瓦朱州议会的候选人达索拉·法迪兰。其他出席者还包括宗教团体、市场商贩、手工业者、政治协会、青年组织和运输工会。阿德莫拉·阿德格比特

https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.summary_zh: 如今，摧毁这一根基的并不只有采矿公司，还包括该国监管机构矿产委员会发布的一项指令。该指令依据《矿产与采矿（本地含量和本地参与）条例》（2020年）（L.I.）予以执行。矿产委员会仍未回答一个核心问题：在塔克瓦、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西制造一个劳动贫困阶层，如何才能最大限度实现加纳黄金产业的国家利益？
https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.body: For years, Ghana's mining communities have lived the classic resource curse. Gold is mined in Tarkwa, Obuasi and Kenyasi, but human rights abuses, environmental destruction, loss of livelihoods, health hazards and social decay are what residents say they get in return. The one exception that sustained these towns was not corporate social responsibility. It was the payslip of the permanent mineworker. That payslip paid the PAYE that funds District Assemblies. It paid SSNIT. It built the markets, the rental houses, and the shops. That foundation is now being dismantled not by mining companies alone, but by a directive from the state's own regulator, the Minerals Commission. Between October 2025 and January 2026, the Minerals Commission issued letters to the last three major companies still practising owner-mining, Newmont, AngloGold Ashanti and Chinese-owned Zijin Mining, ordering them to transition fully from owner-mining to contract mining by December 2026 or face sanctions including fines and mine shutdowns. The directive is enforced under the Minerals and Mining (Local Content and Local Participation) Regulations, 2020 (L.I. 2431). Surface mining must go to wholly Ghanaian-owned firms; underground mining to firms with at least 50% local ownership. Chief Executive Isaac Tandoh defends it philosophically: “Employment is not the same as ownership. Labour is not the same as control. Our people are working in the mines, agree, but do they own the mines?” But the workers who actually risk their lives underground say they were never consulted. According to the Ghana Mineworkers’ Union (GMWU) of TUC Ghana, which represents about 14,000 workers in large-scale mining, the sector has already undergone a silent casualisation. As of the end of 2024, more than 90% of workers were on fixed-term and casual employment, while permanent employment accounted for less than 10%. By 2026, the union says, that figure has climbed above 95%, meaning nineteen out of every twenty mineworkers are on short-term, casual or contract arrangements. The GMWU's August 20, 2026 petition to Lands and Natural Resources Minister Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah is blunt: the contract model is “dangerous, regressive, and economically unsound”. Its study with finance journalist Adnan Adams Mohammed found that when workers move from owner-mining to contractor, wages fall by at least half for the same job. Internal contractor staff confirm contractor workers typically earn around 50% less in basic pay than direct employees of mine operators. Gbana says the loss is wider: lower PAYE, reduced pension contributions, and diminished retirement benefits. “This is not what we intended for local content regulation. This is a complete reversal of what the intentions were,” GMWU General Secretary Abdul-Moomin Gbana told journalists after presenting the petition. “We are totally opposed to the directive. “Local content must therefore create opportunities for all Ghanaians. It cannot become a vehicle for exploitation to enrich a few contractors at the expense of the workers who risk and sweat day and night in the bowels of the earth to produce the wealth,” the petition states. In that same letter, he warned: “We wish to state therefore, without hesitation, that this path is injurious and inimical to the already fragile and precarious conditions of mineworkers. It will inevitably open the floodgates to further exploitation, abuse, casualisation of labour, and the erosion of hard-won protections that workers have fought for over decades”. The economics explain the human cost. Data compiled by the Minerals Commission itself shows operational contract rates have plummeted by over 17% as local contractors undercut each other to win concessions. The Commission now admits it. Chief Executive Isaac Tandoh said: “We have observed instances where mining service rates have fallen significantly... from $3 per tonne to below $2.50, leaving workers worse off”. Yet its solution is to tighten contractor oversight, not suspend the directive. The union says oversight has failed before. It cites Engineers & Planners, held up by government as a model local contractor, which the GMWU says has refused to meet statutory obligations, including SSNIT contributions and Tier 2 pension payments accrued over multiple years. Other contractors named include E&P, Rabotec, BCM, Electrochem and Rocksure. The GMWU is particularly concerned about labour brokers, especially in some Chinese-owned operations, whom it accuses of commodifying labour and subjecting even mining engineers, geologists and metallurgists to precarious conditions. The GMWU says it first wrote to the Minerals Commission on April 23, 2026, after the directive. A meeting on May 26 produced a roadmap to suspend it and form a Technical Committee. That roadmap has stalled. No public cost-benefit analysis has been released on the impact on PAYE, SSNIT, Tier 2, community spending, and safety. Beginning September 1, the union has threatened industrial action, including wearing red armbands across all mines: “It is about bread and butter, and we can’t sit aloof,” Gbana said. The central question remains unanswered by the Minerals Commission: How does creating a class of working poor in Tarkwa, Obuasi and Kenyasi maximise optimal national benefit from Ghana's gold? Until that question is answered, the GMWU's demand stands: suspend the directive and put workers at the centre of policy

https://www.myjoyonline.com/contract-min.body_zh: 多年来，加纳矿业社区一直陷于典型的“资源诅咒”。塔尔夸、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西开采黄金，但居民表示，换来的却是侵犯人权、环境破坏、生计丧失、健康危害和社会衰退。维系这些城镇的唯一例外并非企业社会责任，而是常驻矿工的工资单。这份工资单缴纳了为地方议会提供资金的PAYE，支付了SSNIT款项，还建起了市场、出租房和商铺。如今，拆毁这一根基的不仅是矿业公司，还有国家监管机构Minerals Commission下达的指令。2025年10月至2026年1月，Minerals Commission向仍在采用矿主自营模式的最后三家大型公司Newmont、AngloGold Ashanti和总部位于中国的Zijin Mining发出函件，命令它们到2026年12月前全面从矿主自营模式转为承包开采，否则将面临罚款和关闭矿山等制裁。该指令依据《2020年矿产与采矿（本地内容及当地参与）条例》（L.I. 2431）执行。露天开采必须交由加纳全资持有的企业承揽，地下开采则必须交由本地持股比例至少为50%的企业承揽。首席执行官Isaac Tandoh从理念上为该政策辩护：“就业不等于所有权，劳动不等于控制。我们的人确实在矿山工作，没错，但他们拥有这些矿山吗？”但那些真正在井下冒着生命危险的工人说，他们从未被征询意见。据隶属TUC Ghana、代表约14000名大型矿业工人的加纳矿工工会（GMWU），该行业已经经历了一场无声的临时化。截至2024年底，超过90%的工人从事定期和临时工作，正式就业比例不足10%。工会表示，到2026年，这一数字已升至95%以上，意味着每20名矿工中就有19人采用短期、临时或合同用工安排。GMWU于2026年8月20日呈交给土地与自然资源部长Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah的请愿书措辞直白：承包模式“危险、倒退且经济上不合理”。该工会与财经记者Adnan Adams Mohammed开展的一项研究发现，当工人从矿主自营模式转为承包工时，同一工作的工资至少减半。承包商内部员工证实，承包工的基本工资通常比矿山运营商的直接雇员低约50%。Gbana说，损失的范围更广：PAYE减少、养老金缴款下降、退休福利缩减。GMWU总书记Abdul-Moomin Gbana在提交请愿书后对记者说：“这并不是我们实施本地内容管制的初衷，而是对原有意图的彻底背离。我们坚决反对这项指令。请愿书指出：“因此，本地内容必须为所有加纳人创造机会，不能沦为剥削劳动、以牺牲那些日夜冒着风险、挥洒汗水，在地球深处创造财富的工人为代价，让少数承包商致富的工具。”在同一封信中，他警告道：“因此，我们不得不明确指出，这条道路会损害矿工本已脆弱且不稳定的处境，并与他们的利益相悖。它必然会导致进一步剥削、侵害、劳工临时化，以及侵蚀工人数十年来争取来之不易的保障。”经济账解释了背后的社会代价。Minerals Commission自行汇总的数据显示，随着本地承包商为赢得特许权相互压价，实际承包费率暴跌逾17%。委员会如今也承认了这一点。首席执行官Isaac Tandoh说：“我们已经发现一些矿业服务费率大幅下降的情况……从每吨3美元降至2.50美元以下，使工人的处境更加恶化。”然而，该机构的解决方案是加强承包商监管，而非暂停指令。工会表示，这种监管此前已经失败。它援引了政府树为本地承包商典范的Engineers & Planners，称GMWU指出，该公司拒绝履行法定义务，包括拖欠SSNIT缴款和第二级养老金款项，且已累积多年。其他被点名的承包商包括E&P、Rabotec、BCM、Electrochem和Rocksure。GMWU尤其担心劳务中介，尤其是某些中资企业运营项目中的中介，并指控他们将劳动商品化，使矿业工程师、地质学家和冶金师甚至也陷入不稳定的就业处境。GMWU表示，指令下达后，其于2026年4月23日首次致函Minerals Commission。5月26日举行的一次会议制定了暂停指令并成立技术委员会的路线图，但该路线图目前已经停滞。尚未公开发布任何有关该指令对PAYE、SSNIT、第二级养老金、社区支出和安全影响的成本效益分析。工会威胁称，自9月1日起将采取工业行动，包括在所有矿山佩戴红色臂章。Gbana说：“这是关乎生计的问题，我们不能坐视不理。”Minerals Commission仍未回答核心问题：在塔尔夸、奥布阿西和凯尼亚西制造一个劳动贫困群体，如何实现加纳从黄金开采中取得最大国家利益？在这个问题得到解答之前，GMWU的要求依然成立：暂停指令，并将工人置于政策的核心位置……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 夸拉州进步大会党（APC）在伊洛林举行大型集会，为总统博拉·蒂努布、州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克以及该党州长候选人萨利胡·雅库布-丹拉迪争取支持。组织者称这是一场有20,000人参加的游行，吸引了来自伊洛林西区、伊洛林东区、伊洛林南区、阿萨和莫罗地方政府的党内忠实党员和支持者。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) in Kwara State has staged a mega rally in Ilorin to canvass support for President Bola Tinubu, Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq, and the party’s governorship candidate, Salihu Yakubu-Danladi. The rally, described by its organisers as a 20,000-man march, attracted party faithful and supporters from Ilorin West, Ilorin East, Ilorin South, Asa and Moro local government areas. Organised by the Governor’s Special Adviser on Political Matters, Suleiman Sai Kayi, the rally was aimed at demonstrating support for the APC leadership and its candidates ahead of the 2026 elections. The procession began at the Kwara State University Teaching Hospital (General Hospital) Roundabout and moved through major streets in Ilorin, with participants displaying party colours and chanting solidarity songs. Many supporters wore APC-branded uniforms and caps bearing inscriptions such as ‘My Vote is for APC’ and ‘#Iwaju LaNlo’ as they danced and marched through the state capital. Speaking with journalists, Mr Sai Kayi said the rally was organised to appreciate Governor AbdulRazaq’s performance, particularly in infrastructure development, education and the welfare of workers and pensioners. He described Mr Yakubu-Danladi’s emergence as the party’s governorship candidate as an agenda for continuity, anchored in fairness and justice, and said he was confident the incoming administration would consolidate the present government’s achievements. “The youth are more than any other age group in this rally. We are gathered to appreciate Mallam AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq for giving us SYD. SYD is part of our own constituency,” he said. Mr Sai Kayi added that the APC believed in sustaining the current development trajectory, arguing that Mr Yakubu-Danladi was part of the achievements recorded by the AbdulRazaq administration since 2019. Also speaking, the Senior Adviser and Counsellor to the Governor, Sa’adu Salahu, urged voters not to be swayed by opposition political campaigns but to assess candidates based on their records and contributions to public service. He expressed confidence that the administration’s people-oriented programmes and infrastructure projects would translate into electoral support for the APC and its candidates. Mr Salahu said Governor AbdulRazaq’s leadership had discouraged political violence and promoted political tolerance, contrasting the administration’s approach with what he described as the style of previous governments. “We can have political differences, but you will agree with me that Governor AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq has never encouraged political thuggery, in contrast to the style of the past government,” he said. He also ruled out the possibility of a rainbow coalition gaining political traction in Kwara, insisting that the APC remained confident of winning the 2027 elections across the state. The governor’s aide urged party members to sustain peaceful mobilisation and intensify door-to-door campaigns to secure votes for the party. Similarly, the Director-General of the APC Campaign Council (Central), Abdulrazaq Jiddah, commended party members for their turnout and urged eligible voters to ensure they collected their Permanent Voter Cards when the exercise commenced. The General Manager of the Kwara State Social Investment Programme, Abdulwasiu Tejidini, said the turnout of men, women and youths reflected growing support for the APC and its development agenda. “Today, Kwara Central has spoken. The whole Kwara has spoken, because the good work of His Excellency, the Governor of Kwara State, has really spoken for itself,” Tejidini said, drawing parallels between the development agenda of President Tinubu and that of the Kwara State Government. A former APC House of Assembly aspirant for Share/Oke-Ode Constituency, Abdulrasheed Akogun, described the zoning of the party’s governorship ticket to Kwara North as a historic political breakthrough for the region. Mr Akogun commended Governor AbdulRazaq for what he called his commitment to equity, fairness and justice, adding that the governor provided a level playing field for party members to pursue their ambitions during the primaries, irrespective of their political tendencies. Other dignitaries at the rally included the wife of the governorship candidate, Sa’adat Yakubu-Danladi; lawmakers and candidates Fatima Arinola Lawal and Mariam Yusuf Aladi; Ghali Alaya; the Governor’s Special Adviser on Media, Bashir Adigun; council chairmen from the participating local government areas; and other APC chieftains
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: 2027年：夸拉州全体进步大会党在伊洛林为蒂努布及当地候选人助选
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 夸拉州全进步大会党（APC）在伊洛林举行了一场大型集会，为总统博拉·蒂努布、州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克以及该党州长候选人萨利胡·亚库布-丹拉迪争取支持。组织者称，这场集会是一场有20,000人参加的游行，吸引了来自伊洛林西区、伊洛林东区、伊洛林南区、阿萨和莫罗等地方政府的党内忠实党员和支持者。集会由州长政治事务特别顾问苏莱曼·赛·卡伊组织，旨在表明2026年选举前各方对APC领导层及其候选人的支持。队伍从夸拉州大学教学医院（总医院）环岛出发，沿伊洛林主要街道行进，参与者展示党旗党色，并高唱团结歌曲。许多支持者身穿印有APC标志的服装，戴着写有“我的选票投给APC”和“#Iwaju LaNlo”等字样的帽子，在州首府载歌载舞、推进游行。赛·卡伊先生对记者表示，举办此次集会是为了肯定州长阿卜杜勒拉扎克的施政表现，特别是在基础设施建设、教育以及工人和退休人员福利方面。他称亚库布-丹拉迪先生获推为该党州长候选人，体现了延续既有施政方向的计划，其核心是公平与正义；他相信即将上任的政府将巩固本届政府取得的成果。他说：“青年人在这次集会中的人数超过了其他任何年龄群体。我们聚在一起，是为了感谢马利姆·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克给我们带来了SYD。SYD是我们自己选区的一部分。”赛·卡伊先生补充说，APC相信应维持当前的发展轨迹，并认为亚库布-丹拉迪先生是阿卜杜勒拉扎克政府自2019年以来所取得成就的一部分。州长高级顾问兼顾问萨阿杜·萨拉胡也发表讲话，敦促选民不要被反对党的政治宣传活动左右，而应根据候选人的政绩及其对公共服务的贡献作出评价。他相信，以人为本的项目和基础设施工程将为APC及其候选人带来选举支持。萨拉胡表示，州长阿卜杜勒拉扎克的领导 discourages政治暴力并促进了政治宽容；他还将其治政策与前几届政府的做法进行了对比。他说：“我们可以有政治分歧，但你会同意我的看法，州长阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克从未鼓励政治暴徒行为，这与past government的作风截然不同。”他还排除彩虹联盟在夸拉州获得政治支持的可能性，坚持认为APC有信心在2027年全州选举中获胜。州长助理敦促党内成员维持和平动员，并加强挨家挨户拉票，为该党争取选票。APC竞选委员会（中央）总干事阿卜杜勒拉扎克·吉达也赞扬党员到场，并敦促符合条件的选民在登记开始时领取永久选民卡。夸拉州社会投资项目总经理阿卜杜勒瓦西乌·特吉迪尼表示，男性、女性和青年的参与情况反映出对APC及其发展议程的支持日益增强。特吉迪尼说：“今天，夸拉中区已经作出了选择。整个夸拉州也已经作出了选择，因为夸拉州长阁下的卓有成效的工作已经充分说明了一切。”他将总统蒂努布的发展议程与夸拉州政府的发展议程相提并论。曾竞选谢尔/奥克-奥德选区议员的阿卜杜勒拉希德·阿库贡表示，将该党州长候选人名额划归夸拉北区，是该地区一项历史性的政治突破。阿库贡先生赞扬州长阿卜杜勒拉扎克对公平、公正和正义的承诺，并称州长在党内初选期间为党员追求政治抱负提供了公平竞争的环境，不论其政治倾向如何。出席集会的其他嘉宾还包括州长候选人的妻子萨阿达特·亚库布-丹拉迪、议员和候选人法蒂玛·阿里诺拉·拉瓦勒与玛丽亚姆·优素福·阿拉迪、加利·阿拉亚、州长媒体特别顾问巴希尔·阿迪贡、参会地方政府的区长，以及其他APC党魁

https://leadership.ng/ndc-accuses-tinubu.summary: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of excessive borrowing and poor management of public resources, saying its presidential candidate, Peter Obi, and running mate, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, are determined to reverse what it described as the erosion of Nigeria’s commonwealth.
https://leadership.ng/ndc-accuses-tinubu.summary_zh: 尼日利亚民主党大会（NDC）指控博拉·蒂努布总统政府过度举债并管理公共资源不当，称其总统候选人彼得·奥比和竞选搭档拉比乌·穆萨·夸恩克瓦索决心扭转其所称的尼日利亚共有财富遭到侵蚀的局面。
https://leadership.ng/ndc-accuses-tinubu.body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of excessive borrowing and poor management of public resources, saying its presidential candidate, Peter Obi, and running mate, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, are determined to reverse what it described as the erosion of Nigeria’s commonwealth. The party stated this while reacting to Tinubu’s recent remarks about Obi’s handling of erosion challenges in Anambra State during his tenure as governor. President Tinubu, while addressing supporters at an All Progressives Congress (APC) rally in Akwa Ibom State on Friday, took a swipe at the former Anambra governor, saying he could not control erosion in his state, whereas he had confronted the Atlantic Ocean during his tenure as governor of Lagos State. However, in a statement issued on Saturday, the Spokesperson of the NDC National Presidential Campaign Council, Dr Chiogo Constance Ikokwu, said the mission of the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket went beyond environmental challenges to addressing what she described as the rapid depletion of the nation’s collective wealth. Ikokwu said the party was concerned about the contradiction between the expected financial benefits of petrol subsidy removal, the Federal Government’s continued borrowing and inadequate funding of critical sectors. She argued that Nigerians deserved explanations on how the financial gains from subsidy removal and increased government revenue were being utilised, particularly against the backdrop of rising debt obligations and inadequate funding for healthcare and education. The NDC spokesperson said the party would not allow Nigeria to continue accumulating debts without corresponding improvements in the living conditions of citizens, who she noted were already battling poverty, unemployment, insecurity and declining purchasing power. To support its position, the party compared the financial records of Obi and Tinubu during their respective tenures as governors of Anambra and Lagos states. According to Ikokwu, Obi left investments valued at the equivalent of $500 million, alongside local and foreign currency holdings, including $156 million in dollar-denominated bonds, when he left office in Anambra State in 2014. In contrast, she cited Debt Management Office figures which, according to her, put Lagos State’s external debt at approximately $190.43 million at the end of 2007, when Tinubu handed over to his successor. The party also criticised the pension law enacted during Tinubu’s administration in Lagos, which it said provided lifetime benefits for former governors and their deputies. It listed the benefits as pensions equivalent to 100 per cent of the incumbent governor’s basic salary, houses in Lagos and Abuja, multiple vehicles, furniture and utility allowances, free medical care, house maintenance allowances and provisions for domestic staff. Ikokwu said the package was excessive and was subsequently reviewed by a succeeding administration, adding that Obi did not establish a similar pension scheme for former governors in Anambra State. The NDC maintained that the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket offered Nigerians an opportunity to move away from what it described as a borrowing-dependent economic model towards prudent management of public resources, accountability, productive investments and improved citizens’ welfare. It also warned that excessive borrowing without accountability could undermine the country’s economic stability, citing historical examples of nations that experienced decline following unsustainable debt and poor fiscal management. Defending Obi’s record on erosion management, the party said the former governor helped attract and launch the World Bank-assisted Nigeria Erosion and Watershed Management Project (NEWMAP) in Anambra State. It added that his administration introduced drainage requirements for new state roads and executed local flood-control projects in communities including Adazi Nnukwu, Amawbia and Umuoji. The party further claimed that Obi regularly engaged the Federal Government on the need for ecological intervention funds and accountability in their utilisation. It said the ultimate objective of the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket was to halt what it called fiscal recklessness and the depletion of Nigeria’s commonwealth while creating economic opportunities for present and future generations. https://leadership.ng/ndc-accuses-tinubu.body_zh: 尼日利亚民主党（NDC）指控总统博拉·蒂努布政府过度借债并管理公共资源不当，称该党总统候选人彼得·奥比及其竞选搭档拉比乌·穆萨·夸恩克瓦索决心扭转其所称的尼日利亚共有财富流失。蒂努布最近谈及奥比在担任阿南布拉州州长期间应对水土流失问题后，该党作出了上述表态。蒂努布总统周五在阿夸伊博姆州举行的全进步大会党（APC）集会上向支持者讲话时，讽刺这位前阿南布拉州州长，称他无法控制本州的水土流失，而蒂努布在担任拉各斯州州长期间却曾与大西洋相抗。然而，NDC全国总统竞选委员会发言人奇奥戈·康斯坦丝·伊科克武博士周六发表声明称，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合的使命不止于解决环境挑战，还包括应对她所称的国家共有财富迅速枯竭问题。伊科克武表示，该党关注到燃油补贴取消后预期的财政收益、联邦政府持续借债以及关键部门资金不足之间存在矛盾。她认为，尼日利亚民众理应得到解释，了解取消补贴带来的财政收益和政府收入增加如何得到利用，尤其是在债务负担上升、医疗和教育资金不足的背景下。NDC发言人称，该党不会允许尼日利亚在民众生活状况没有相应改善的情况下继续累积债务；她指出，民众已经在与贫困、失业、不安全局势和购买力下降作斗争。为支持自身立场，该党比较了奥比和蒂努布分别担任阿南布拉州州长和拉各斯州州长期间的财政记录。据伊科克武称，奥比2014年离开阿南布拉州州长职位时，留下价值相当于5亿美元的投资，以及本币和外币资产，其中包括1.56亿美元的美元计价债券。相比之下，她援引债务管理办公室的数据称，2007年底蒂努布将拉各斯州州长职位移交给继任者时，该州外债约为1.9043亿美元。该党还批评了蒂努布在拉各斯州任内制定的养老金法，称该法向前州长及其副手提供终身福利。所列福利包括相当于在任州长基本工资100%的养老金、在拉各斯和阿布贾的住房、多辆汽车、家具和公用事业津贴、免费医疗、房屋维护津贴以及 Domestic Staff 待遇。伊科克武称，这套待遇过于优厚，后来由继任政府重新审查；她还表示，奥比没有为阿南布拉州前州长设立类似养老金计划。NDC坚称，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合为尼日利亚民众提供了摆脱其所谓依赖借债的经济模式、转向审慎管理公共资源、落实问责、开展生产性投资和改善民众福祉的机会。该党还警告，缺乏问责的过度借债可能破坏国家经济稳定，并列举了一些国家在不可持续债务和财政管理不善之后走向衰落的历史事例。为奥比在水土流失治理方面的政绩辩护，该党称这位前州长帮助吸引并启动了世界银行援助的尼日利亚水土流失与流域管理项目（NEWMAP）在阿南布拉州的实施。他还引述称，奥比任内为新建州级道路设置了排水要求，并在阿达齐·恩努库、阿马夫比亚和乌穆奥吉等社区实施了地方防洪项目。该党进一步声称，奥比经常就开展生态干预以及监督资金使用等问题与联邦政府交涉。他说，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合的最终目标是制止其所谓的财政鲁莽行为和尼日利亚共有财富流失，同时为当代和子孙后代创造经济机会。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家观点，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，随时掌握全天候最新消息 → 加入我们的 WhatsApp 频道 --> --> 阿德穆·伊达克沃 阿德穆·伊达克沃是 Leadership Media Group 的记者，拥有23年工作经验，专攻政治和人物故事报道。他的 published work 对尼日利亚及非洲各地的政治讨论产生了影响。

Unlock these with Subscription Bangladesh's Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman on Sunday (November 8, 2026) described ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina as a "convicted criminal" and said Dhaka has requested India to extradite her, according to local media reports. Responding to questions from journalists after inaugurating a training workshop in Dhaka, Mr. Asaduzzaman said the government was taking all necessary legal steps to bring Ms. Hasina back from India and would follow due process. "To me, she is a criminal. A criminal convicted by our tribunal. To us, this is her identity," he said, according to a report on bdnews24 website. Asked about bringing Ms. Hasina back to Bangladesh, the Law Minister said the government would act in accordance with the law and would not be guided by emotion. "Although the Law Ministry is not directly involved in this matter, the Ministry of Home Affairs is concerned, as it relates to the extradition treaty with India. The matter will be dealt with in accordance with the law, leaving no room for emotions. We have requested her repatriation under the treaty and through due process," Mr. Asaduzzaman was quoted as saying by the state-run BSS news agency. Bdnews24 also quoted Mr. Asaduzzaman as saying: "That is a matter for the Indian government. We have made requests to them under the extradition treaty." "If they hand her over to us, we will hand her over in the due process, as required under the law," he added. India has previously acknowledged receiving Bangladesh's extradition requests for Ms. Hasina but has not announced any decision on handing her over. The Ministry of External Affairs has said the requests are being examined as part of its established processes. Ms. Hasina fled Bangladesh for India on August 5, 2024, following a mass uprising that ended her 15-year rule. An interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus subsequently took charge. Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal in November 2025 convicted Ms. Hasina of crimes against humanity committed during the July-August 2024 uprising. The tribunal, which tried her in absentia, sentenced her to death on one charge and life imprisonment on another. In February this year, Bangladesh held parliamentary elections and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) led by Tarique Rahman formed the government. During an audio-only virtual press conference organised in New Delhi on August 5, Ms. Hasina said she intended to return to Bangladesh in December despite the possibility of being imprisoned or killed. The interaction drew a sharp reaction from Dhaka, whose Foreign Ministry said it was "outraged" that Ms. Hasina had been allowed to engage with the media. India distanced itself from the event, saying it was organised by a private media entity and that the government had no involvement whatsoever in it. 据当地媒体报道，孟加拉国法律部长Md Asaduzzaman于2026年11月8日星期日称被推翻的首相Sheikh Hasina是“已被定罪的罪犯”，并表示达卡已请求印度将她引渡回国。

Asaduzzaman先生在达卡主持一场培训研讨会开幕式后回答记者提问时表示，政府正采取一切必要法律措施，将Hasina女士从印度带回，并会依法办理相关程序。据bdnews24网站报道，他说：“在我看来，她是一名罪犯，一名被我国法庭定罪的罪犯。对我们而言，这就是她的身份。”

当被问及将Hasina女士带回孟加拉国一事时，这位法律部长表示，政府将依法采取行动，不会受情绪左右。

据国家通讯社BSS引述，Asaduzzaman先生说：“尽管法律部没有直接参与此事，但内政部与此案有关，因为这涉及我们与印度之间的引渡条约。此事将依法处理，不给情绪留下任何空间。我们已依据该条约并通过正当程序提出将她遣返的要求。”

Bdnews24还引述Asaduzzaman先生的话说：“这是印度政府应处理的事情。我们已依据引渡条约向他们提出要求。”

他补充道：“如果他们将她交给我们，我们就会按照法律要求，通过正当程序将她移交。”

印度此前曾确认收到孟加拉国关于引渡Hasina女士的请求，但尚未宣布是否会将她移交。印度外交部表示，这些请求正作为既定程序的一部分接受审查。

Hasina女士于2024年8月5日因一场推翻其15年执政的群众起义而逃离孟加拉国，前往印度。此后，由诺贝尔奖得主Muhammad Yunus领导的临时政府接管国家事务。

2025年11月，孟加拉国国际刑事法庭裁定Hasina女士犯有在2024年7月至8月起义期间实施的危害人类罪。该法庭在缺席审判她后，就一项罪名判处死刑，并就另一项罪名判处无期徒刑。

今年2月，孟加拉国举行议会选举，由Tarique Rahman领导的孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）组建政府。

在8月5日于新德里组织的一场仅提供音频接入的虚拟新闻发布会上，Hasina女士表示，尽管可能遭到监禁或杀害，她仍打算在12月返回孟加拉国。这一互动引发达卡方面的强烈反应。孟加拉国外交部称，对于Hasina女士获准与媒体互动一事，它感到“愤慨”。

印度与该活动保持距离，称活动由一家私人媒体机构组织，政府绝对没有参与。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110803.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 미국 중간선거 이후 처음으로 미국 고위급과 한자리에서 만나게 돼 한미 안보 협의의 불씨를 살릴 수 있을지 주목된다. 8일 외교부에 따르면 조 장관은 올해 제2차 주요 7개국(G7) 외교장관 회의 참석을 위해 이날 프랑스 파리로 출국했다. 회의에는 마코 루비오 미국 국무부 장관의 참가도 확정돼 지난 4일 결과가 나온 미국 중간선거 이후 조 장관과 루비오 장관이 처음 대면하게 된다. 다만 여러 일정이 맞물리는 다자회의 특성에다 주최국 프랑스가 국내 시위 때문에 개최지를 마르세유에서 파리로 급히 변경하는 등 다소 어수선한 분위기 속에서 루비오 장관과의 양자회담 개최 여부는 아직 정해지지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 막판 성사 가능성도 없지 않지만, 현재로서는 최근 주요 20개국(G20) 외교장관 회의 때처럼 풀어사이드(약식 회동) 형식으로 마주칠 공산이 큰 상황이다. 조 장관은 미국 중간선거 전이던 지난달 30일 미국 애틀랜타에서 열린 G20 회의를 계기로 루비오 장관과 풀어사이드 형식의 환담을 하고 당시 주요 이슈였던 국내 정치인들의 미국 비자 발급 문제 등을 논한 바 있다. 앞서 9월 18일에는 조 장관이 미국 워싱턴DC를 방문해 루비오 장관과 정식 회담을 갖고 대미투자, 안보협의, 호르무즈 사안, 북미대화 등 현안에 대해 의견을 교환했다. 조 장관이 파리에서 루비오 장관과 대면하게 될 경우 우선 거론될 의제로는 한국의 원자력연료 농축·재처리와 핵추진 잠수함 연료 조달을 논의할 안보 협의 진척, 호르무즈 항행 자유 기여 이슈 등이 꼽힌다. 안보 협의는 지난해 11월 한미 조인트팩트시트(공동설명자료) 발표 이후 올해 6월 첫 실무회의를 개최한 뒤로 소식이 없다. 호르무즈의 경우 정부가 최근 청해부대 임무 영역 확대를 발표하면서 '실질적 기여'에 조금이나마 다가선 상태다. 문제는 루비오 장관이 속한 도널드 트럼프 공화당 행정부가 선거 참패 이후 한미 안보협의 등에서 치고 나갈 동력이 있느냐 하는 점이다. 행정부 간 정상회담에서 합의한 사안으로 의회가 개입할 여지가 적다고는 하나, 지금까지도 이란 전쟁 등으로 협의에 소극적이었던 미 행정부 실무진이 현시점에서 한미 안보 협의에 적극적으로 나서기를 기대하긴 어렵다는 관측이 나온다. 그렇다고 해도 안보 협의는 한국 정부로서는 지속해서 추진 동력을 만들어 나가야 하는 사안이고, 미국 정치 제도상으로도 행정부가 주도하는 업무인 만큼 미측과 소통을 이어 나갈 것이라는 입장이라고 한 소식통은 전했다. 조 장관은 주최국 프랑스와는 양자 회담을 가질 것으로 예상되며, 영국이나 독일 등 주요국과도 별도 회담을 추진할 것으로 보인다. 유럽 국가들은 호르무즈 해협 자유항행에 대한 국제사회의 움직임을 주도해 왔으므로 조 장관은 최근 결정한 청해부대 임무 영역 및 전력 확대를 이들 국가에 언급하면서 한국의 기여 의지를 강조할 수 있다. 유럽의 최대 안보 불안 요소 중 하나인 우크라이나 전쟁과 관련해 유럽 국가들이 한국 입장을 문의할 가능성이 제기되기도 한다. 유럽 주요 일간지인 영국 파이낸셜타임스(FT)는 한국이 러시아와 관계 개선을 모색하는 움직임을 보인다며 일부 유럽 외교관들이 '유사입장국으로 여겼던 한국에 대해 계속 신뢰할 수 있는지' 의문을 제기한다는 보도를 지난달 내놓은 바 있다. 한국이 북한군 포로 송환 비공개 합의 파기를 이유로 우크라이나와 외교 관계를 축소했다는 점 또한 유럽의 시선에서 우려로 작용한다. 유럽 측이 이런 사안을 제기할 경우 조 장관은 한국이 러시아로 기운다는 우려는 사실과 다르며, 우크라이나 전쟁 종식과 평화 회복을 위한 국제사회 노력을 지지한다는 정부 기본 입장을 강조할 전망이다. 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관 역시 이번 회의에 참석하며 G7 국가들과 별도 세션을 가질 예정이라고 우크라이나 매체가 전했다. 시비하 장관이 파리에 가면 그간 양국 외교 갈등 해결을 위해 물밑에서 노력해 온 조 장관과 따로 접촉해 사안을 논의할 가능성도 있다. （首尔=韩联社）记者金志献=外交部长赵显将首次在美国中期选举后同美国高级官员会面，能否为韩美安全磋商注入活力引人关注。外交部8日表示，赵显部长当天启程前往法国巴黎，准备出席今年第二次七国集团（G7）外长会议。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥也已确认参会，因此这是美国中期选举结果于4日公布后，赵显部长与鲁比奥部长的首次会面。不过，由于多边会议日程相互交织，主办国法国因国内示威将举办地仓促从马赛改为巴黎，整体气氛显得有些混乱，据悉双方是否举行双边会谈尚未敲定。到最后促成会谈并非没有可能，但目前来看，两人很可能像近期二十国集团（G20）外长会议期间一样，以双边接触（简短会晤）形式见面。上个月30日美国中期选举前，赵显部长借赴美国亚特兰大出席G20会议之机，与鲁比奥部长以双边接触形式交谈，讨论了当时的主要议题，包括国内政治人物赴美签证发放问题。此前9月18日，赵显部长访问美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，与鲁比奥部长举行正式会谈，就对美投资、安全磋商、霍尔木兹海峡问题及朝美对话等当前议题交换了意见。若赵显部长在巴黎与鲁比奥部长会面，预计首先讨论的议题包括：为推进安全磋商而探讨韩国核燃料浓缩与再处理、核动力潜艇燃料采购；为霍尔木兹海峡航行自由作贡献等。自去年11月韩美发布联合情况说明文件以来，安全磋商于今年6月举行首次工作会议后便再无消息。在霍尔木兹海峡问题上，韩国政府最近宣布扩大清海部队任务范围，某种程度上向“实质性贡献”迈进了一步。问题在于，鲁比奥部长所在的唐纳德·特朗普共和党政府在选举惨败后，是否有动力在韩美安全磋商等领域采取行动。虽然国会介入政府间首脑会谈所达成共识事项的空间不大，但有观察认为，鉴于美国政府工作层迄今在伊朗战争等问题上对磋商持消极态度，目前难以期待其在现阶段积极推动韩美安全磋商。即便如此，对韩国政府而言，安全磋商仍是需要持续创造推动力的事项，而且从美国政治制度来看，这属于政府主导的工作，因此韩方将继续与美国方面沟通。一消息人士透露，预计赵显部长将与主办国法国举行双边会谈，并可能同英国、德国等主要国家另行会谈。欧洲国家此前一直主导国际社会围绕霍尔木兹海峡自由航行采取行动，因此赵显部长在提及韩国最近决定的清海部队任务范围及兵力扩充时，可能向这些国家强调韩国的贡献意愿。也有人提出，欧洲国家可能就乌克兰战争询问韩方立场。乌克兰战争是欧洲最大的安全忧虑因素之一。欧洲主要日报英国《金融时报》在上月报道称，韩国正寻求改善与俄罗斯的关系，并引述一些欧洲外交官质疑，人们此前将韩国视为“立场相近国家”，如今能否继续信任韩国。韩国以朝韩战俘遣返非公开共识破裂为由缩减与乌克兰的外交关系，这一点也从欧洲视角引发担忧。鉴于欧洲方面可能提出这些问题，预计赵显部长将强调政府的根本立场，即韩国不存在倒向俄罗斯的担忧，并支持国际社会为结束乌克兰战争、恢复和平所作的努力。乌克兰外长安德烈·西比哈也将出席此次会议，并计划同G7国家举行单独场次。据乌克兰媒体报道，西比哈部长赴巴黎后，可能另行接触一直为缓解两国外交摩擦在幕后努力的赵显部长，讨论相关问题。版权(c) 韩联社，禁止未经许可转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月8日17:17发布。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방장관과 새뮤얼 퍼파로 미군 인도·태평양사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 가능성이 제기됐다. 8일 홍콩 사우스차이나모닝포스트(SCMP) 등에 따르면 스티븐 올린스 미중관계전국위원회(NCUSCR) 회장은 지난 6일 중국 하이난성 싼야에서 열린 '글로벌 해양협력·해양 거버넌스 포럼'에 화상으로 참석해 두 사람의 방중 가능성을 언급했다. 올린스 회장은 "헤그세스 장관과 퍼파로 사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 수 있는 것으로 알고 있다"며 "두 사람의 방문이 양국 군 당국 간 소통을 정례화하는 데 도움이 될 것"이라고 말했다. 그는 양국이 군사적 오판으로 인한 충돌을 방지하기 위해 모든 수준에서 군사 교류를 정례화하고, 충돌이 발생하더라도 신속한 소통으로 긴장을 완화할 수 있는 체계를 마련해야 한다고 촉구했다. SCMP는 소식통을 인용해 미중이 최근 몇 달간 헤그세스 장관의 중국 방문 문제를 논의했으며 연내 방문이 성사될 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 지난 9월 워싱턴에서 열린 미중 정상회담 이후 헤그세스 장관과 둥쥔 중국 국방부장의 상호 방문 가능성도 논의된 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 헤그세스 장관은 최근 미국 중간선거에서 공화당이 패배한 이후 탄핵 압박을 받고 있어 거취가 불투명한 상황이다. 공화당 일각에서도 이란 전쟁 수행 등을 문제 삼아 탄핵을 추진하고 민주당도 국방부 운영에 대한 조사를 준비하고 있어서다. 그러나 트럼프 대통령은 여전히 그에 대한 신임을 유지하고 있다. 또 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 성사된다면 2015년 이후 약 11년 만에 미국의 태평양지역 최고 군사령관이 중국을 방문하게 된다. 중국 난징대 국제관계학원 주펑 원장은 SCMP에 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 미중 양국 군 당국 간 실무급 소통을 강화하는 계기가 될 수 있다고 평가했다. 미 국방부에 따르면 양국 국방 당국자들은 지난 2∼3일 워싱턴에서 '위기 소통·예방 실무그룹' 연례회의를 열고 군사적 위험을 줄이기 위한 방안을 논의했다. 앞서 지난 8월에는 퍼파로 사령관이 캐나다에서 양즈빈 중국 인민해방군 동부전구 사령원과 만나 군사적 오판을 막기 위한 고위급 소통의 중요성을 논의했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 14:24 송고 2026년11월08일 14시24분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）驻华记者韩宗求报道称，美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯与美军印太司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗近期可能访华。据《南华早报》（SCMP）等媒体8日报道，中美关系全国委员会（NCUSCR）会长史蒂文·奥林斯于6日以视频方式出席在海南省三亚举行的“全球海洋合作·海洋治理论坛”，并提到上述两人可能访华。奥林斯会长表示：“据了解，赫格塞斯部长和帕帕罗司令近期可能访问中国。两人的访问将有助于推动两国军方当局之间的沟通机制化。”他还敦促两国在所有层级将军事交流机制化，以防止因军事误判而引发冲突，并建立即使发生冲突也能通过迅速沟通缓解紧张的体系。《南华早报》援引消息人士称，中美双方近几个月来讨论了赫格塞斯部长访华问题，并称其年内成行可能性较高。据报道，在华盛顿举行的中美领导人会谈后，双方曾讨论赫格塞斯部长与中国国防部长董军互访的可能性。不过，由于美国近期中期选举中共和党败选后，赫格塞斯部长面临弹劾压力，其行踪目前并不明朗。共和党内部也有人以对伊朗战争的处置等问题为由推动弹劾，民主党亦准备就国防部的运作展开调查。然而，特朗普总统仍对赫格塞斯表示信任。此外，如果帕帕罗司令访华成行，将是美国太平洋地区最高军事指挥官自2015年以来时隔约11年首次访问中国。中国南京大学国际关系学院院长周峰向《南华早报》评价称，帕帕罗司令访华可能成为加强中美两国军方当局务实层级沟通的契机。据美国国防部介绍，两国国防部门官员于2日至3日在华盛顿举行“危机沟通与预防工作组”年度会议，讨论降低军事风险的办法。此前在8月，帕帕罗司令曾在加拿大会见中国人民解放军东部战区司令杨志斌，并就避免军事误判、加强高级别沟通的重要性交换了意见。报道由KakaoTalk账号okjebo提供。版权所有©韩联社，未经许可禁止转载·再分发及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月8日14时24分发布。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 目前，全球对这些材料的供应以及相关采矿计划不足以满足不断增长的需求。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已将对中国关键矿物的依赖列为主要国家安全风险，并宣布投入数十亿美元，在国内外建设新的矿产和采矿项目。在巴西，美国试图遏制中国的采矿投资，同时重申其在整个拉丁美洲的领先地位。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: OXFORD — Two tumultuous elections have captured headlines this week. In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated his far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. And in Serbia, the student-led opposition ousted Aleksandar Vučić after 14 years in power. But the challenge for these new governments is just beginning. Whether they like it or not, both will be swept up in the global scramble for critical minerals and metals. Critical minerals and metals are essential to build modern infrastructure, implement advanced technologies, and pursue decarbonization. They are vital inputs in electricity grids, wind turbines, solar panels, batteries, electric vehicles, and energy storage. And Brazil and Serbia both possess them: Brazil holds the world’s second-largest reserve of rare earths (after China), estimated at 21 million tons (Mt), and Serbia has significant stores of coal and lithium, as well as copper, gold, and other metals. As it stands, global supplies of these materials, and mining plans for them, are insufficient to meet growing demand. For example, BloombergNEF projects a copper-supply shortfall of 44% of projected global demand by 2050. This has further intensified competition between China and the United States for control of these resources. China is in pole position in this race: the International Energy Agency reports that it is now the top refiner of 19 of 20 key strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. But the US is committed to strengthening its position. Having identified dependence on China for critical minerals as a key national-security risk, U.S. President Donald Trump has announced billions of dollars in investments in new mineral and mining projects at home and abroad. Resource politics has penetrated almost all corners of U.S. foreign policy, including relations with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Denmark and Greenland, Ukraine, and Venezuela. In Brazil, the US is trying to contain Chinese mining investment, while re-asserting its preeminence across Latin America. In Serbia, the U.S. government has said for years that a greater presence for American firms is necessary to “displace” China, which has invested “billions of dollars” in mines and other related projects. For countries like Brazil and Serbia, the challenge is to attract the investment they need to leverage their resources for their own benefit, without losing popular support. It is a tricky proposition. Both countries have experienced deadly mining accidents in recent years. In 2019, the Brumadinho dam collapsed, releasing a deluge of toxic mud from Brazil’s Córrego do Feijão iron ore mine that killed 270 people. In 2022, a partial collapse of Serbia’s Soko coal mine led to a sudden release of methane, killing eight miners. If either of these countries is to expand mining operations, the public must trust that it can be done safely. But the Sino-American competition, coupled with soaring global demand, could easily drive down standards in the mining sector. By pushing out companies with better projects, agreements shaped by weak anti-corruption enforcement, conflicts of interest, or hostility toward environmental, social, and governance standards — all of which are apparent in the U.S. nowadays — could lead to less competitive, less safe, and more socially and environmentally harmful arrangements. The US and China want their investments in mining and processing to deliver the biggest and fastest returns possible. Governments in resource-rich countries like Brazil and Serbia will have to navigate such external pressures in a way that does not undermine their legitimacy at home. But mining companies must also build legitimacy in the communities where they operate, lest host countries throw them under the bus if public opinion sours. This has been apparent in Guinea, Mali, and Niger, where governments have lately revoked dozens of mining licenses. In Kenya, the government recently ordered the immediate suspension of mining operations by Tata Chemicals Magadi over “regulatory non-compliance.” Among the issues it identified were the lack of a clear mineral-beneficiation and value-addition strategy, outstanding royalty reconciliation and payment obligations, and inadequate export reporting. Tata Chemicals’ performance was also found wanting when it came to implementing community development agreements, employment and skills-transfer plans for Kenyans, local procurement, and environmental compliance. This is not just a list of terms for the firm’s relationship with government. It captures the broader relationships—with local workers and suppliers, with surrounding communities, and with the nation as a whole—on which the company’s resilience and legitimacy depended. Another recent case reinforces the point. First Quantum’s Cobre Panamá — one of the world’s largest copper mines, which cost some $10 billion to develop and contributed about 5 percent of Panama’s GDP in 2022 — was shuttered in late 2023, following nationwide protests over the mine’s environmental impact. The Canadian company’s original contract included a tax holiday until the capital costs of building the mine were recouped, and a royalty of just 2 percent of revenue. In March 2023, the government made a new deal with First Quantum, which included a 25 percent corporate income tax, 12–16 percent royalties, and a yearly minimum payment of $375 million, in addition to social security contributions, municipal taxes, acreage fees, water charges, and environmental obligations. But Panama’s Supreme Court ruled that the legislation on which that agreement rested violated 25 constitutional articles, covering environmental protection, public welfare, health, and the state’s obligations to its citizens. Panama’s government may yet want to reopen the mine (even if just to shut it sustainably), but any new concession will have to be grounded in legislation aligned with constitutional principles. For mining companies seeking to operate in Brazil, Serbia, or anywhere else, resilience requires more than navigating host-country politics and not getting kicked out. will benefit companies that progress from “tolerated” to “trusted” by offering transparency, respect, and responsiveness to local concerns. Ngaire Woods is dean of the Blavatnik School of Government at the University of Oxford and a non-executive director at Rio Tinto. This article was distributed by Project Syndicate
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 采矿业的新地缘政治格局
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 牛津——本周，两场动荡的大选占据 headlines。在巴西，现任总统卢伊兹·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦击败了极右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。在塞尔维亚，由学生领导的反对派在亚历山大·武契奇执政14年后迫使他下台。但这些新政府面临的挑战才刚刚开始。无论愿不愿意，两国都将被卷入全球争夺关键矿产和金属的竞赛。关键矿产和金属对于建设现代基础设施、实施先进技术以及推进脱碳至关重要。它们是电网、风力涡轮机、太阳能板、电池、电动汽车和储能系统的重要投入品。巴西和塞尔维亚都拥有这些资源：巴西拥有仅次于中国的全球第二大稀土储量，估计达2100万吨（Mt）；塞尔维亚则拥有大量煤炭和锂，以及铜、金和其他金属。目前，全球这些材料的供应及其采矿计划不足以满足不断增长的需求。例如，BloombergNEF预计，到2050年，铜供应缺口将达到预计全球需求的44%。这进一步加剧了中国和美国争夺这些资源控制权的竞争。中国在这场竞赛中处于有利地位：国际能源署报告称，中国现在是20种关键战略矿产中19种的最大精炼国，平均市场份额为70%。但美国决心加强自身地位。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将关键矿产对中国的依赖列为一项关键国家安全风险，并宣布投资数十亿美元在国内及海外建设新的矿产和采矿项目。资源政治已经渗透到美国外交政策的几乎所有角落，包括与刚果民主共和国、丹麦和格陵兰、乌克兰以及委内瑞拉的关系。在巴西，美国试图遏制中国的采矿投资，同时重新确立自己在拉丁美洲的优势。在塞尔维亚，美国政府多年来一直表示，需要让美国企业拥有更广泛的存在，以“取代”中国；中国已在矿山及其他相关项目上投资“数十亿美元”。对于巴西和塞尔维亚这样的国家来说，挑战在于吸引所需投资，利用自身资源为本国谋利，同时不失去公众支持。这是一项微妙的难题。近年来，两国都发生过致命的矿难。2019年，布鲁马迪纽大坝坍塌，巴西科尔雷朱·杜·费热昂铁矿的有毒泥浆洪流决堤，造成270人死亡。2022年，塞尔维亚索科煤矿发生局部坍塌，甲烷突然泄漏，8名矿工死亡。如果这两个国家中的任何一个要扩大采矿业务，公众必须相信采矿能够安全进行。但中美竞争加上全球需求飙升，可能轻易导致采矿行业标准下降。通过排挤拥有更优项目的企业，在反腐败执法不力、利益冲突或敌视环境、社会和治理标准的协议框架下开展业务——这些在美国如今都十分明显——可能导致竞争力更弱、安全性更差，并造成更大社会和环境危害的安排。美国和中国都希望其对采矿和加工的投资获得最大、最快的回报。巴西和塞尔维亚等资源丰富国家的政府将不得不应对这种外部压力，同时不损害自身在国内的合法性。但矿业公司也必须在所在社区建立合法性，否则一旦公众舆论转坏，东道国可能会把公司当成弃子。这一情况在几内亚、马里和尼日尔十分明显，这些国家的政府最近撤销了数十张采矿许可证。在肯尼亚，政府最近以“违反监管规定”为由，命令 Tata Chemicals Magadi 立即暂停采矿业务。其认定的问题包括缺乏明确的矿产选冶和增值战略、未完成的特许权使用费核算与支付义务，以及出口报告不足。在执行社区发展协议、为肯尼亚人制定就业和技能转移计划、本地采购以及环境合规方面，Tata Chemicals 的表现也被认为不尽如人意。这不仅仅是一系列涉及公司与政府关系的条款。它涵盖了更广泛的关系——与当地工人和供应商、周边社区以及整个国家的关系——而公司的韧性和合法性正依赖于这些关系。另一个近期案例进一步印证了这一点。First Quantum 的 Cobre Panamá 铜矿是全球最大的铜矿之一，开发成本约100亿美元，2022年贡献了巴拿马国内生产总值约5%，但在2023年末因该矿的环境影响引发全国性抗议而被关闭。这家加拿大公司的原始合同包括税收假期，直至建矿的资本成本收回；此外还有仅占收入2%的特许权使用费。2023年3月，政府与 First Quantum 达成新协议，规定征收25%的企业所得税、12%至16%的特许权使用费以及每年最低付款3.75亿美元，此外还须缴纳社会保障金、地方税、土地面积费、水资源费并履行环境义务。但巴拿马最高法院裁定，该协议所依据的法律违反了宪法中的25项条款，涉及环境保护、公共福利、健康以及国家对公民所承担的义务。巴拿马政府或许仍希望重新开放这座矿山（即便只是为了以可持续方式关闭它），但任何新的特许协议都必须建立在符合宪法原则的法律基础上。对于希望进入巴西、塞尔维亚或其他任何地方经营的矿业公司而言，仅需应对东道国政治并避免被赶出去，并不足以构成韧性。提供透明度、尊重并回应地方关切，将有助于企业从“被容忍”转变为“受信任”。Ngaire Woods 是牛津大学布拉瓦特尼克政府学院院长，也是力拓的非执行董事。本文由 Project Syndicate 分发

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title: 중국군 장성 4명, 전인대 대표직 사퇴…3년간 50명 자격 상실

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）权淑姬记者＝中国军队近期有4名少将退出全国人民代表大会（相当于韩国国会）代表职务。据路透社和中国经济媒体财新等8日报道，6日在北京闭幕的第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十五次会议宣布，人民解放军少将等共9人辞去全国人大代表职务。辞去职务的4名少将中，包括广东省军区司令员张弓此前和宁夏军区政委郭建军等。此前在今年举行的全国人大常委会会议上，也有多名军队高级将领和国防工业相关人士被取消全国人大代表资格。财新统计称，自习近平担任中国国家主席并展开强力反腐行动以来，已有数十名高级将领和军官受到清洗。财新称，自第十四届全国人大于2023年产生以来，3年间共有46名来自人民解放军和武警部队的全国人大代表被免职。军队和武警部队所属全国人大代表此次并非被免职，而是以辞职方式离开代表职务，这是2023年以来首次。报道可通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习与利用。2026年11月8日13时43分发布。

https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body: An wallafa Sa'o'i 2 da suka wuce Lokacin karatu: Minti 3 An gudanar da zaɓen Majalisar Dokokin Amurka ranar Talata, 3 ga watan Nuwamba, 2026, domin zaɓen mambobin majalisar biyu, wato Majalisar Dattawa da Majalisar Wakilai. Sakamakon zaɓen ya nuna cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta samu kujeru fiye da jam'iyyar Republican, wadda Shugaba Donald Trump yake wakilta. A yayin zaɓen, an samu wasu abubuwa da ba a yi tsammani ba, ciki har da nasarar 'yan Najeriya da sauran Baƙaƙen fata da suka samu kujeru a majalisun dokokin Amurka. Fiye da 'yan takara goma sha biyu ’yan asalin Najeriya sun samu nasarar lashe kujerun wakiltar mazabu daban-daban a Amurka, ciki har da waɗanda ke jihohin Maryland, Texas, Pennsylvania da Georgia, da kuma birnin Washington DC. Will Jawando ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen shugabancin gundumar Montgomery da ke jihar Maryland, bayan ya kayar da Esther Wells ta jam'iyyar Republican. Ofishin babban jami’in tsaro na gundumar Montgomery ya naɗa Jawando a matsayin sabon shugaban rundunar 'yan sandan yankin. Jawando mamba ne a Majalisar Gundumar Montgomery. Dan asalin Najeriya ne, kasancewar mahaifinsa ɗan Najeriya ne, yayin da mahaifiyarsa Ba'amurkiya ce. A jihar Texas, Junior Ezeonu mai shekaru 27 ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 101 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar, bayan ya kayar da ɗan majalisar mai ci, Chris Turner, a zaɓen fitar da gwani. An haifi Ezeonu a Onitsha, jihar Anambra ta Najeriya, amma ya koma jihar Texas da ke Amurka yana ɗan shekara biyu. A shekarar 2021, an zaɓe shi a matsayin mamba a Majalisar Ƙaramar Hukumar Grand Prairie. Daga baya kuma ya zama mutum mafi ƙarancin shekaru da ya taɓa riƙe muƙamin mataimakin magajin garin na wucin gadi a tarihin birnin. Carol Kazeem, 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat, ta sake lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 159 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Pennsylvania. Kazeem na daga cikin 'yan siyasa baƙaƙen fata na farko da suka samu nasarar lashe kujerun majalisa a Amurka a zaɓen shekarar 2022. A birnin Washington DC, Oye Owolewa ya samu nasarar lashe ɗaya daga cikin kujerun wakilci na bai ɗaya a Majalisar Gundumar Columbia. Owolewa, wanda masani ne a fannin harhaɗa magunguna, iyayensa sun fito daga jihohin Kwara da Osun ne na Najeriya, waɗanda suka yi hijira zuwa Amurka. A baya, ya riƙe muƙamin wakilin je-ka na-yi-ka Gundumar Columbia (Shadow Representative). Kundin tsarin mulkin Amurka ya tanadi cewa Gundumar Columbia za ta kasance jiha mai cin gashin kanta. Sai dai har yanzu ba ta da cikakken ikon kaɗa ƙuri'a a Majalisar Wakilan Amurka. Adeyina, wanda aka haifa a Najeriya kuma mamba ne a jam'iyyar Democrat, ya sake lashe zaɓe domin komawa Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia. An fara zaɓen Adeyina zuwa Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Georgia ne a shekarar 2022, inda yake wakiltar wasu sassan gundumar Gwinnett. Shi ne babban daraktan kwamitin ba da shawarwari ga al'ummar Najeriya mazauna Amurka (Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee), wata ƙungiya da ke wayar da kan jama'a kan muhimmancin zaɓe, tare da taimaka wa baƙin haure da ke zaune a Amurka wajen yin rajistar zaɓe. Shi ma Gabe Okoye na jam'iyyar Democrat ya sake lashe zaɓe, inda zai koma Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia domin ci gaba da wakiltar mazaɓa ta 102. https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body_zh: 美国国会中期选举再过2天：周二，即2026年11月3日，将举行美国国会选举，选举众议院参议院和众议院议员。结果显示，民主党获得的席位比共和党多，共和党由总统唐纳德·特朗普代表。选举结果还出现了一些出人意料的情况，包括尼日利亚裔人士和其他亚裔人士在美国国会中取得进展。超过12名尼日利亚出生的候选人成功赢得美国不同选区的代表席位，其中包括马里兰州、得克萨斯州、宾夕法尼亚州、佐治亚州以及华盛顿特区。Will Jawando在击败共和党的Esther Wells后，成功赢得马里兰州蒙哥马利县县长选举，蒙哥马利县治安官办公室任命Jawando为新的县治安官。Jawando是蒙哥马利县议会成员。他是尼日利亚裔，父亲是尼日利亚人，母亲是美国人。在得克萨斯州，27岁的Junior Ezeonu在初选中击败现任议员Chris Turner后，成功赢得得克萨斯州众议院第101选区代表席位。Ezeonu出生于尼日利亚阿南布拉州奥尼察，但两年前移居美国得克萨斯州。2021年，他当选为大草原市法律市议会成员。后来，他又成为该市历史上最年轻的市政议员副手候选人。民主党人Carol Kazeem再次赢得宾夕法尼亚州众议院第159选区代表席位。Kazeem属于首批赢得美国议会议席的非裔美国政治人士，这些人士在2022年选举中取得突破。在华盛顿特区，Oye Owolewa赢得哥伦比亚特区议会仅有的一个代表席位。Owolewa以反毒工作闻名，父母来自尼日利亚夸拉州和奥孙州，后来移民美国。此后，他担任哥伦比亚特区影子代表。美国的政府体制规定，哥伦比亚特区应享有州级地位，但目前仍未在美国众议院获得完整的投票权。出生于尼日利亚的民主党人Adeyina再次当选，重新返回佐治亚州众议院。2022年，Adeyina首次竞选佐治亚州众议院议员，代表格温内特县的其他乡村地区。他是旅美尼日利亚人公共咨询委员会（Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee）的主席，该组织向公众宣传选举的重要性，并协助居住在美国的大批非洲人登记投票。民主党人Gabe Okoye也再次赢得选举，将返回佐治亚州众议院，继续代表第102选区。2024年美国选举 尼日利亚 唐纳德·特朗普 美国政治 突发 特朗普 连任 竞选活动 02:04 视频、Tinubu可能面临的州份 2027年选举、2分04秒 01:11 视频、PSG是世界上哪支最强的足球队？、1分11秒 02:18 视频、是什么引发了Kwankwaso与ADC之间的冲突？、2分18秒 04:04 视频、‘我与南方同僚建立了牢固关系’、4分04秒 01:40 视频、Ilhan Omar：谁在众议院与特朗普针锋相对？、1分40秒 01:28 视频、尼日利亚2027年可能出现的5位女性总统人选、1分28秒 04:46 视频、‘Hollywood演员比女性承担更多责任’、4分46秒 01:45 视频、在尼日利亚导致儿童早婚和失去受教育机会的因素、1分45秒 02:41 视频、仍在为尼日利亚推动足球的北方人、2分41秒 03:50 视频、如何确认你的号码是否在NCC关闭之列、3分50秒 01:39 视频、是什么让Tinubu的选举委员会陷入困境？、1分39秒 01:39 视频、尼日利亚最贫困的州份、1分39秒 03:04 视频、尼日利亚公民在2027年前面临的困境、3分04秒 02:04 视频、这位百岁老人正在书写历史、2分04秒 特朗普连任竞选结束

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body: • Abuja, Lagos, Kwara, Oyo to get improved supply in 24 hours The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) Limited has countered the claims by the Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO), and the Federal Ministry of Power that operational constraints on gas transportation network was responsible for the recent decline in electricity generation. This is just as the Minister of Power, Mr. Joseph Tegbe, yesterday promised that electricity supply to Abuja, Lagos, Kwara and Oyo states, which were currently experiencing outages would improve within the next 24 hours. The Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) has also rejected claims by Ikeja Electric (IKEDC), attributing several Band A feeder outages to “grid instability” and assigning responsibility to the transmission company. NNPCL’s Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, said in a statement yesterday that the gas network operated by NNPC Gas Infrastructure Company Limited (NGIC), a subsidiary of the NNPC, remained available to support gas deliveries to power-generating stations nationwide. “NGIC’s operational records do not indicate transportation-related constraints within its network that explain the current decline in electricity generation,” Odeh said. NNPC’s clarification followed a November 5 statement by the NISO, which attributed the lower power generation partly to limited gas availability and reduced water inflows into hydroelectric stations. Specifically, the system operator said the limited availability of “gas has constrained the capacity of affected thermal generating stations to operate at their available levels, while reduced water inflows into reservoirs have impacted the generation capacity of hydroelectric power stations”. Tegbe also attributed the electricity supply shortfall to planned maintenance at the Egbin Power Station in Lagos and constraints in gas supply to some thermal power stations, which had reduced the amount of electricity available on the national grid. “Grid operators have, therefore, implemented load shedding in some areas to manage the shortfall. Sabotage of key transmission lines has also restricted the use of alternative routes to supply some locations, especially Lagos,” the minister explained. But the NNPC said the availability of its gas transportation infrastructure should be assessed separately from gas production, commercial supply arrangements, and actual deliveries to individual power plants. The company said gas production volumes had grown by about 10 percent year-to-date in 2026, citing efforts to implement the federal government’s gas development and monetisation agenda. “Gas supply availability is therefore not a challenge as NNPC remains committed to supporting efforts to improve electricity generation through safe, reliable and efficient gas supply and transportation,” it said. The company said determining the cause of the power shortfall required a broader assessment of the gas-to-power value chain. According to the oil firm, the review should cover the availability and operational readiness of generating units, plant maintenance schedules, and actual gas offtake, noting that these factors determine whether gas supplied to power plants can be converted into electricity. “Gas production, commercial supply arrangements and actual deliveries to individual power plants must be assessed separately from the availability of transportation infrastructure,” the NNPC said. The company called for a coordinated review of operational data by gas suppliers, transporters, power generators, and NISO to identify specific constraints and determine appropriate interventions. In an update on the power situation, Tegbe said he was aware of the strain the outages had placed on households and businesses in the four affected areas. Tegbe said his team was working to return the affected generating units to service in phases, with the first units expected to come back online within 48 to 72 hours, counting down from yesterday. He said the ministry was also working with operators to improve gas supply and accelerate repairs to the damaged infrastructure. Tegbe also applauded residents of the affected states for their patience. “I thank everyone affected for their patience and will provide further updates as supply is gradually restored,” he stated. The current outages, which have lasted several days, have hit the four states, leaving many households and businesses in extended blackout and forcing reliance on alternative power sources. In the areas impacted by the power cuts, Discos had announced load shedding schedules, with many Band A customers complaining of sharp drops in supply hours. The situation, the minister earlier said, was compounded by reduced generation from hydro stations due to low water levels, gas constraints to thermal stations, among others, which he stressed limited wheeling to the power distributors. Meanwhile, the TCN has rejected claims by IKEDC attributing several Band A feeder outages to “grid instability”. In a statement TCN issued yesterday, the transmission company said the attribution contained in IKEDC’s public notice of November 5 was “inaccurate and misleading.” TCN said by virtue of Section 67 of the Electricity Act, 2023, the determination of the root cause of disturbances, shortfalls and interruptions on the national grid falls exclusively within the defined functions of the Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO). “IKEDC, like every other market participant, has no authority to make such determinations, and NISO has made none attributing the outages in IKEDC’s notice to TCN,” it said. The company said NISO had already clarified the position in its public statement of November 5, attributing the current decline in power generation to constraints in gas supply to thermal power stations and reduced output from hydroelectric stations due to lower reservoir inflows. According to TCN, NISO explained that the development reduced available generation, which in turn reduced energy allocated to Discos and led to fewer hours of supply and increased load shedding across distribution networks. “The shortfall in supply to IKEDC’s customers is a consequence of reduced generation and the resulting allocation, not of any failure of TCN’s transmission network. TCN can only transmit the energy made available to it and cannot transmit energy that is not generated,” it said. TCN said records for all feeders supplying IKEDC confirmed the picture painted by NISO. Of the interruptions recorded on November 1 and 2, it said 68 per cent were frequency-control load shedding arising from low generation, 26 per cent were due to IKEDC’s non-compliance with load allocation by the National Control Centre (NCC) of NISO, or to faults and works on IKEDC’s own network, while the remaining 6 per cent were TCN planned maintenance, switching or a line limitation. “None of the recorded interruptions was a TCN equipment fault or trip,” it added. Of the 46 interruptions recorded on the 33kV feeders named in IKEDC’s notice, TCN said 29 were frequency-control load shedding arising from low generation and 14 were recorded against IKEDC – nine for non-compliance with load allocation and five for faults or trips on its own network. According to the TCN, the other three were scheduled for maintenance on the Ogba-Alimosho line on November 1. TCN urged IKEDC and other Discos to “desist forthwith from making unfounded claims about the causes of supply shortfalls to their customers,” saying such claims misinformed customers, undermined public confidence and obscured the real challenges to be resolved by the relevant stakeholders. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司反驳电力部长，称天然气管网并非电力供应下降的原因
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body_zh: 阿布贾、拉各斯、夸拉和奥约州将在24小时内获得改善的电力供应。尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited反驳了尼日利亚独立系统运营商（NISO）和联邦电力部的说法，后者称天然气运输网络的运行限制是近期发电量下降的原因。电力部长约瑟夫·特格比先生昨天承诺，目前正经历停电的阿布贾、拉各斯、夸拉州和奥约州的电力供应将在未来24小时内改善。尼日利亚输电公司（TCN）也否定了 Ikeja Electric（IKEDC）的说法。IKEDC将多条A类馈线停电归因于“电网不稳定”，并把责任推给输电公司。NNPCL首席企业传播官安迪·奥德昨天在一份声明中表示，由NNPC子公司NNPC天然气基础设施有限公司（NGIC）运营的天然气网络仍可支持向全国发电站输送天然气。“NGIC的运行记录并未显示其网络内存在可以解释当前发电量下降的运输相关限制，”奥德说。NNPC的澄清紧随NISO于11月5日发表的声明。该声明将发电量下降部分归因于天然气供应有限以及水电站入水量减少。系统运营商具体表示，天然气供应有限“制约了受影响的火力发电站按可用水平运行，而水库入水量减少影响了水电站的发电能力”。特格比还把电力供应不足归因于拉各斯Egbin发电站的计划检修，以及部分火力发电站面临的天然气供应限制，这些因素减少了国家电网可供应的电量。“因此，电网运营商已在部分地区实施限电，以管理供应缺口。关键输电线路遭到破坏也限制了通过替代路线向一些地点供电，尤其是拉各斯，”部长解释道。但NNPC表示，评估其天然气运输基础设施的可用性时，应将其与天然气生产、商业供应安排以及向各电厂的实际交付分别开来。公司称，2026年初至今天然气产量增长约10%，并将此归因于落实联邦政府天然气开发与变现议程的努力。“因此，天然气供应的可获得性并非挑战，因为NNPC仍致力于通过安全、可靠和高效的天然气供应与运输，支持改善发电量的努力。”公司表示，要确定电力供应短缺的原因，需要对从天然气到电力的价值链进行更广泛的评估。这家石油企业称，审查应涵盖各发电机组的可用性和运行准备状态、电厂检修计划以及天然气实际提取量，并指出这些因素决定供应给电厂的天然气能否转化为电力。“天然气生产、商业供应安排以及向各电厂的实际交付，必须与运输基础设施的可用性分开评估，”NNPC说。公司呼吁天然气供应商、运输商、发电企业和NISO协调审查运行数据，以查明具体限制因素并确定适当的干预措施。在有关电力局势的最新通报中，特格比表示，他了解停电给受影响四个地区的家庭和企业造成的压力。特格比说，他的团队正分阶段努力恢复受影响发电机组的运行，从昨天起算，首批机组预计将在48至72小时内重新上线。他说，部长还在与运营商合作，以改善天然气供应并加快受损基础设施的维修。特格比还赞扬了受影响各州居民的耐心等待。“我感谢所有受影响人士的耐心，并将在供应逐步恢复后提供进一步通报，”他表示。目前持续数日的停电已波及这四个州，许多家庭和企业长时间陷入黑暗，被迫依赖替代电源。在停电影响地区，各配电公司已宣布限电安排，许多A类客户抱怨供电时长大幅减少。部长早前表示，低水位导致水电站发电减少以及火力发电站面临天然气限制等因素，使情况更加复杂，这些因素限制了向配电公司输送的电量。与此同时，TCN否定了IKEDC将多条A类馈线停电归因于“电网不稳定”的说法。TCN昨天发布声明称，这家输电公司表示，IKEDC在11月5日公开通知中作出的归因“不准确且具有误导性”。TCN称，根据《2023年电力法》第67条，确定全国电网干扰、供应短缺和停电根本原因的工作，完全属于尼日利亚独立系统运营商（NISO）的既定职能。“IKEDC与其他所有市场参与者一样，无权作出此类判断；NISO也未作出任何将IKEDC通知所列停电归因于TCN的决定，”它说。公司表示，NISO已在11月5日的公开声明中澄清有关情况，将当前发电量下降归因于向火力发电站供应天然气所受的限制，以及水库入水量减少导致水电站出力下降。据TCN称，NISO解释道，这一情况减少了可用发电量，进而减少了分配给各配电公司的电量，并导致供电时间缩短和各配电网限电增加。“IKEDC客户供应不足是发电量减少及其相应分配结果所致，并非TCN输电网络发生任何故障。TCN只能输送提供给它的电能，无法输送未生成的电能，”它说。TCN表示，为IKEDC供电的所有馈线记录均证实了NISO所描述的情况。11月1日和2日记录的停电中，68%是因发电量低而实施的频率控制限电，26%是由于IKEDC未遵守NISO国家控制中心（NCC）的负荷分配，或因IKEDC自身网络发生故障和施工，剩余6%则是TCN的计划检修、线路切换或线路容量限制。“记录的停电中没有一次源于TCN设备故障或跳闸，”它补充说。在IKEDC通知中列明的33千伏馈线上记录的46次停电中，TCN表示，29次是因发电量低而实施的频率控制限电，14次记在IKEDC名下，其中9次因不遵守负荷分配，5次因其自身网络故障或跳闸。据TCN称，另外3次停电计划于11月1日对Ogba-Alimosho线路进行维护。TCN敦促IKEDC及其他配电公司“立即停止就向客户供应短缺的原因作出毫无根据的说法”，并表示，此类说法会误导客户、削弱公众信心，并掩盖有关利益相关方需要解决的实际难题。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.summary: The African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) has approved a $30 million financing facility for the Nigeria Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) to improve access to funding for export-oriented small and medium enterprises (SMEs), strengthen industrial production and boost Nigeria’s participation in intra-African trade.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.summary_zh: 非洲进出口银行（Afreximbank）已批准一项3000万美元的融资安排，用于支持尼日利亚进出口银行（NEXIM），改善出口导向型中小企业的融资渠道，强化工业生产，并推动尼日利亚参与非洲内部贸易。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body: The African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) has approved a $30 million financing facility for the Nigeria Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) to improve access to funding for export-oriented small and medium enterprises (SMEs), strengthen industrial production and boost Nigeria’s participation in intra-African trade. The facility was formalised through a signing ceremony during the opening of the 2026 Creative Africa Nexus Weekend (CANEX WKND) in Lagos. According to a statement issued yesterday, the financing package comprises a $20 million revolving working capital facility and a $10 million medium-to-long-term loan facility. NEXIM revealed that the approval was a significant milestone that reinforced confidence in Nigeria’s export financing ecosystem and the bank’s role in supporting the federal government’s export diversification agenda. The facility was expected to support businesses involved in exports, intra-African trade, manufacturing, commodity processing and value-added production, while strengthening Nigeria’s position in continental trade under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). It was also expected to provide much-needed financing for SMEs, stimulate industrial production, expand export capacity and create employment opportunities across strategic sectors of the economy. Beyond the financing, beneficiary businesses would have access to capacity-building programmes, export-readiness initiatives and Afreximbank’s trade facilitation platforms, including MANSA, TRADAR Club and the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS). The platforms were designed to expand market access and improve the participation of African businesses in regional and continental trade. The approval aligned with the federal government’s commitment to expanding non-oil exports, strengthening SME competitiveness, deepening industrialisation, creating sustainable employment and enhancing foreign exchange earnings. NEXIM, Nigeria’s export credit agency, was mandated to promote the diversification of the country’s export base through financing, guarantees, insurance and advisory services to export-oriented businesses. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.title_zh: NEXIM获得非洲进出口银行3000万美元融资，为出口导向型中小企业提供资金
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body_zh: 非洲进出口银行（Afreximbank）已批准一项3000万美元融资安排，用于支持尼日利亚进出口银行（NEXIM）改善出口导向型中小企业的融资渠道、强化工业生产，并提升尼日利亚在非洲内部贸易中的参与度。该融资安排在拉各斯举行的2026年非洲创意 nexus 周末（CANEX WKND）开幕式上通过签署仪式正式确立。根据昨日发布的声明，这套融资方案包括一项2000万美元循环营运资金安排和一项1000万美元中长期贷款安排。NEXIM表示，此次获批是一项重要里程碑，增进了市场对尼日利亚出口融资生态以及该银行支持联邦政府出口多元化议程的信心。这项融资安排预计将支持从事出口、非洲内部贸易、制造业、商品加工和增值生产的企业，同时巩固尼日利亚在非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）框架下的大陆贸易地位。它还将为中小企业提供亟需的融资，激发工业生产、扩大出口能力，并在经济各战略领域创造就业机会。除融资支持外，受益企业还将获得能力建设计划、出口准备度 initiatives 以及 Afreximbank 的贸易便利化平台，包括 MANSA、TRADAR Club 和泛非支付与结算系统（PAPSS）。这些平台旨在拓宽市场准入渠道，改善非洲企业参与区域及大陆贸易的情况。此次获批与联邦政府扩大非石油出口、增强中小企业竞争力、深化工业化、创造可持续就业和提升外汇收益的承诺相一致。NEXIM 是尼日利亚的出口信贷机构，其职责是通过融资、担保、保险和咨询服务推动出口导向型企业发展，实现该国出口基础多元化。THISDAY 于1995年1月22日创办，由 THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD. 出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕 Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的全平台新闻媒体，该报服务于政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶层，同时充当有抱负者和千禧一代探索新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公众信任，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区议题，直至探讨人类与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/l.body: Tsunami, a stunning rebuke, judgement, trouncing, complete repudiation, referendum, crushing, and landslide were some of the various words used to describe the Democrats’ defeat of the Republicans in the United States’ midterm elections held last Tuesday. The outcome of the polls sent a clear message to President Donald Trump that his remaining two years in office would not be without political resistance. For a long time to come, the midterm elections would be remembered by many Americans, particularly those who had hoped for a change in the balance of power in Congress. In what many described as an end to the reign of terror, the Democratic Party broke several decades-long Republican winning streaks, recorded historic firsts and flipped both chambers of Congress. Voters in states and districts that had supported Trump’s re-election just two years earlier delivered a harsh verdict on his administration’s policies, including steep tariffs, rising fuel prices, corruption allegations, hardline immigration enforcement policies and the unresolved conflict with Iran. By the time the results were announced, Democrats had secured 255 seats in the House of Representatives and 54 in the Senate, while Republicans won 134 seats in the House and 44 in the Senate. The results marked a significant shift in the balance of power in Washington. The Democratic gains extended into territories Trump had carried comfortably in 2024, including Texas, South Carolina and Kansas. Democrat James Talarico, who won the Senate election in Texas, attributed his victory to a different approach to politics. “We didn’t win this race by alienating our neighbours or shaming our neighbours or ridiculing our neighbours. We embodied a new kind of politics. A politics rooted in a deep love for our state, for our country and, most importantly, for all of our neighbours,” he said. Before the elections, Trump had urged supporters to vote as though he were on the ballot. After the results, however, he claimed on social media that he would have won “IN A LANDSLIDE!” The results suggested otherwise, with voters appearing to judge his administration’s performance. Reportedly, 62 per cent of voters disapproved of his performance, while 38 per cent approved. Nearly 90 per cent identified the cost of living as a major factor in their vote, while nearly two-thirds believed his policies had worsened the economy. More than half also expressed reservations about his leadership and priorities. Trump’s interventions in the closing days of the campaign also appeared to backfire, with controversial remarks attracting attention away from his party’s agenda. The question now is how Trump will respond to the setback. Known for his combative approach to criticism, he has said he would accept the election results and work with Democrats. Whether he will maintain that position remains to be seen. Democratic control of Congress gives the party greater leverage to challenge Trump’s agenda, including his tariffs, healthcare policies and military actions in Iran. The House could also investigate allegations of profiteering involving his family and associates, while impeachment proceedings have been raised as a possibility. Inside the Republican Party, initial shock at the stunning election results quickly gave way to anger with Trump. They argued that his focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost the party the elections. Some said the president dragged them down with unpopular policies, a low job approval rating and obsession over construction projects in Washington. Unlike what he did in the presidential election in 2024 when Trump was on the ballot, not even the about $500million the billionaire businessman Elon Musk, put down to boost Republicans chances in the polls save the day. As Nigeria approaches its 2027 general election, the American experience raises questions about whether voters will similarly use the ballot to express dissatisfaction with an incumbent government. Many Nigerians are grappling with economic hardship, inflation, insecurity, corruption, inadequate electricity and poor infrastructure, among other challenges. The American experience raises questions about whether voters in Nigeria will similarly use the ballot to express dissatisfaction with President Bola Tinubu and other candidates of his All Progressives Congress (APC) as the country approaches its 2027 elections. This is because economic grievances that contributed to the Republican defeat are not alien to Nigeria where Nigerians face many of them in far more debilitating circumstances. Economic hardship necessitated by cost of food, transportation, healthcare, electricity, corruption, nepotism, deplorable roads and insecurity has placed unbearable pressure on households. Inflation has diminished purchasing power, while government policies have imposed enormous adjustment costs on ordinary citizens. Millions are struggling to cope with economic hardship, even as those in positions of authority offer explanations, justifications and assurances. Beyond the economy, questions of democratic accountability, institutional independence, governance and the exercise of executive power remain central to Nigeria’s political discourse. These are fundamental to the survival of any functioning democracy. Despite the hardship and insecurity in the country, APC is confident that it would win the election in landslide. Those who spoke to THISDAY urged Nigerians to use similar factors to rate and assess the ruling APC in 2027, citing the defeat of the Republicans as an example of how citizens can hold governments accountable through the ballot box. Their views point to a central question ahead of the election: will Nigerians primarily judge the APC-led federal government by its record in office or will political loyalty, regional identity, ethnicity, religious bigotry, financial inducements and party machinery play a more decisive role? A lawyer, Samson Afegbai, identified five issues that could influence the election: Insecurity, foreign exchange, the government’s subsidy policy, the cost of living and infrastructure. Femi Adeyinka similarly identified the economy as a decisive factor. He feels that the removal of the petrol subsidy and the unification of the foreign exchange market under Tinubu have had significant implications for fuel prices, transportation and purchasing power. Although the government has defended the reforms as necessary to correct longstanding economic distortions, voters will be interested in whether they translate into tangible improvements in living conditions before 2027. The candidates must therefore demonstrate how their economic policies can improve household incomes, employment, electricity supply and business conditions. While Tinubu will be judged on his administration’s record, Atiku and Obi must convince voters that their alternatives offer a credible route to recovery. Another respondent and businessman, Emeka Odittah, identified six factors that could shape the election: The economy, coalition-building, voter turnout, security, religion and zoning, and the credibility of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC). The businessman placed particular emphasis on electoral credibility, arguing that public confidence in the voting and result-transmission processes could influence participation and acceptance of the outcome. He said the credibility of INEC, particularly the use of the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System, the INEC Result Viewing Portal and the collation of results, would be crucial to public confidence in the election. According to Odittah, the 2027 contest would be shaped by economic hardship and the ability of candidates to build cross-regional coalitions while securing public trust in the electoral process. This is why the ADC urged Nigerians to draw lessons from the American elections and vote out the APC in 2027. In a statement issued by its National Publicity Secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, the party drew parallels between the American elections and Nigeria’s political situation under President Tinubu, arguing that voters should prioritise their welfare over political loyalty, sentiments and the personalities of political leaders. “Americans have shown that when politicians become arrogant, when policies punish ordinary people, and when those in power mistake popularity for a permanent licence to govern, the ballot box remains the ultimate instrument of accountability,” the party said. The ADC urged Nigerians to consider the country’s economic and security challenges before deciding whether to renew the APC’s mandate. It accused the Tinubu administration of presiding over worsening economic hardship, insecurity and declining opportunities, arguing that the ruling party should not be rewarded with another term. “We cannot continue to complain about the cost of living while voting for a President who has made life unaffordable. We cannot demand security while rewarding failure,” the party said. For the Human Rights Writers Association of Nigeria (HURIWA), the outcome of the US midterm elections should serve as an important lesson to Nigeria’s electoral authorities and political leaders on the need to guarantee credible, transparent and peaceful elections. In a statement by its National Coordinator, Emmanuel Onwubiko, the group stressed that the victories by Democratic candidates and the transfer of control of both chambers of the Congress demonstrated the importance of allowing voters to determine political outcomes through credible electoral processes. HURIWA argued that electoral credibility is strengthened when voters can independently verify results and political parties have confidence that the declared outcome reflects the ballots cast. It called on the Chairman of INEC, Professor Joash Amupitan, and other election managers to draw lessons from established democracies and ensure that Nigeria’s January 2027 national elections are free, fair, transparent and peaceful. It also warned that any attempt to manipulate the 2027 elections could trigger serious political instability and undermine public confidence in constitutional democracy. The American experience offers a reminder that electoral victories are not permanent endorsements of political parties or their leaders. But whether Nigerians will apply that lesson in 2027 remains to be seen. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/l.title_zh: 尼日利亚可从美国中期选举中汲取的2027年 election 经验
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/l.body_zh: 海啸、令人震惊的驳斥、惨败、彻底否定、全民公投、压倒性胜利和 landslide victory，都是人们用来描述民主党上周二在美国中期选举中击败共和党的词语。投票结果向唐纳德·特朗普总统传达了一个明确信息：他任期剩余的两年不会没有政治阻力。很长一段时间以来，许多美国人都不会忘记这次中期选举，尤其是那些曾希望国会权力平衡发生变化的人。许多人将这一结果描述为恐怖统治的终结；民主党打破了共和党延续数十年的连胜纪录，取得了多个历史性首次，并赢得国会两院翻转。两年前曾支持特朗普连任的州和选区选民，对他政府的政策作出了严厉裁决，其中包括高额关税、燃油价格上涨、腐败指控、强硬的移民执法政策，以及尚未解决的伊朗冲突。.results公布时，民主党已确保在众议院获得255席、在参议院获得54席，共和党则赢得众议院134席和参议院44席。结果标志着华盛顿权力平衡的重大变化。民主党的 gains 还延伸到了特朗普2024年轻松获胜的地区，包括得克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州和堪萨斯州。赢得得克萨斯州参议院选举的民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科将胜利归因于一种不同的政治方式。“我们赢得这场选举，靠的不是排斥邻人、羞辱邻人或嘲笑邻人。我们展现了一种全新的政治，一种根植于对我们州、我们国家，最重要的是对我们所有邻人的深厚热爱之中的政治。”他说。选举前，特朗普曾敦促支持者投票时就好像他本人也在选票上。然而结果公布后，他在社交媒体上声称自己本会“以压倒性优势获胜！”结果却显示并非如此，选民似乎对其政府的表现作出了评判。据报道，62%的选民不认可他的表现，38%的选民予以认可。近90%的选民将生活成本列为影响投票的主要因素，近三分之二的人认为他的政策使经济状况恶化。超过一半的选民还对其领导能力和优先事项表示保留。特朗普在竞选最后几天的干预似乎也适得其反，其争议言论吸引了外界对政党议程的关注之外。眼下的问题是，特朗普将如何回应这次挫折。特朗普以对抗性的方式处理批评著称，他曾表示将接受选举结果，并与民主党合作。他能否维持这一立场仍有待观察。民主党控制国会，使该党拥有更大的筹码去挑战特朗普的议程，包括他的关税、医疗保健政策以及在伊朗的军事行动。众议院还可能调查涉及其家人和关联人士牟取暴利的指控，同时弹劾程序也被列为一种可能性。共和党内部对惊人选举结果最初的震惊，很快转为对特朗普的愤怒。他们认为，他专注于个人政治遗产，无视选民的关切，最终让该党输掉了选举。有些人表示，总统以不受欢迎的政策、低下的工作支持率以及痴迷于华盛顿的建筑项目拖累了他们。与2024年总统选举中特朗普亲自参选时不同，这位富豪商人埃隆·马斯克投入约5亿美元助力共和党在民调中胜出，也未能挽救败局。随着尼日利亚临近2027年大选，美国的经历引出了一个问题：尼日利亚选民是否会同样借助选票表达对现任政府的不满。许多尼日利亚人正艰难应对经济困境、通货膨胀、治安不佳、腐败、电力供应不足和基础设施落后等诸多挑战。美国经历引出了一个问题：随着该国临近2027年选举，尼日利亚选民是否会同样借助选票，表达对博拉·蒂努布总统及其全进步大会党（APC）其他候选人的不满。这是因为，导致共和党败选的经济不满，对尼日利亚而言并不陌生；尼日利亚人面临许多类似问题，而且处境更加严重。食品、交通、医疗保健、电力、腐败、任人唯亲、糟糕的道路和治安不佳所造成的经济困境，给家庭施加了难以承受的压力。通货膨胀削弱了购买力，政府政策则给普通民众带来巨大的调整成本。数百万人艰难应付经济困境，而身居权力职位的人却不断作出解释、辩解和保证。经济之外，民主问责、制度独立、治理以及行政权的行使，仍是尼日利亚政治话语的核心。这些都是任何正常运转的民主制度得以存续的基础。尽管该国困难重重、治安不稳，APC仍信心十足，认为自己将以压倒性优势赢得选举。向THISDAY发表意见的人士敦促尼日利亚人运用类似因素，在2027年评价和审视执政的APC，并以共和党败选为例，说明公民如何通过投票箱追究政府责任。它们的观点指出了选举前的一个核心问题：尼日利亚人主要会根据APC主导的联邦政府任内表现来评判它，还是政治忠诚、地区认同、族裔、宗教偏见、经济诱因和政党机器将发挥更决定性的作用？律师桑松·阿费格拜列出了可能影响选举的五个问题：治安、外汇、政府的补贴政策、生活成本和基础设施。费米·阿德因卡同样认为经济是决定性因素。他认为，取消燃油补贴以及在蒂努布领导下统一外汇市场，对燃油价格、交通和购买力产生了重大影响。尽管政府为这些改革辩护，称其是纠正长期经济扭曲所必需的，但选民会关注这些改革能否在2027年前转化为生活条件的切实改善。因此，候选人必须展示其经济政策如何改善家庭收入、就业、电力供应和商业环境。蒂努布将根据其政府的执政记录受到评判，而阿提库和奥比则必须说服选民，其替代方案提供了一条可信的复苏道路。另一位受访者、商人埃梅卡·奥迪塔列出了可能左右选举的六个因素：经济、建立联盟、选民投票率、安全、宗教与地区平衡，以及独立国家选举委员会（INEC）的公信力。这位商人特别强调选举公信力，认为公众对投票和结果传输流程的信心会影响参与度及对结果的接受。他说，INEC的公信力，特别是双模选民登记系统的使用、INEC结果查看门户以及结果汇总，将对公众对选举的信心至关重要。据奥迪塔称，2027年的竞选将受到经济困境以及候选人能否建立跨地区联盟并赢得公众对选举程序信任的影响。正因如此，ADC敦促尼日利亚人从美国选举中汲取教训，并在2027年投票将APC选下台。该党由全国宣传秘书博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希发表声明，将美国选举与蒂努布总统治下的尼日利亚政治局势相类比，主张选民应把自身福祉置于政治忠诚、情绪以及政治人物个性之上。该党说：“美国人已经表明，当政客变得傲慢，当政策惩罚普通民众，当掌权者误把受欢迎程度当作永久执政许可证时，投票箱仍是问责的最终工具。”ADC敦促尼日利亚人在决定是否再次赋予APC授权之前，审视该国面临的经济和治安挑战。它指责蒂努布政府任内经济困境加剧、治安恶化、机会减少，认为不应让执政党再获一个任期。该党说：“我们不能一边抱怨生活成本，一边投票支持一位让生活变得难以承受的总统。我们不能一边要求安全，一边奖励失败。”对尼日利亚人权作家协会（HURIWA）而言，美国中期选举的结果应成为对尼日利亚选举机构和政治领导人的重要警示，促使其确保选举可信、透明、和平。该组织由全国协调员埃manuel·翁武比科发表声明，强调民主党候选人的胜选以及国会两院控制权易手，证明了允许选民通过可信选举程序决定政治结果的重要性。HURIWA认为，当选民能够独立核验结果、政党确信公布的Outcome reflects the ballots cast时，选举公信力就会得到加强。它呼吁INEC主席乔阿什·阿穆皮坦教授及其他选举管理人员从成熟民主国家汲取教训，确保尼日利亚2027年1月的全国大选自由、公平、透明、和平。它还警告，任何操纵2027年选举的企图都可能引发严重政治不稳定，并削弱公众对宪政民主的信心。美国经历提醒人们，选举胜利并非对政党或领导人的永久背书。但尼日利亚人是否会在2027年运用这一教训，仍有待观察。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY
